service.title: Which imaging study do you want reviewed?
service.text: Choose an imaging type and who the request is for. The system verifies technical details after the DICOM upload.

clinical.title: What specific question should the expert answer?
clinical.text: The main question is required. Other clinical details can be added as needed without making the patient feel trapped in a long form.
clinical.questionPlaceholder: For example: I want to know whether the finding described in the first report has changed compared with prior imaging.

images.title: Upload your medical images.
images.text: This step is required. In the prototype, files are not sent to a server; selected files are shown in the interface.

documents.title: Add supporting documents.
documents.text: This step is optional. Radiology reports, discharge summaries, pathology reports or lab results can be added when useful.
